title: マイコンプログラミング
subtitle: Microcontroller Programming
educationalGoal: (1) Learn the foundations of microcontrollers (2) Learn the method for writing microcontroller programs
advice: This is a basic course in writing programs for microcontrollers. We will cover the following topics: 1. I/O port programming for AVR and Arduino microcontrollers. 2. Timer interrupt programming for AVR and Arduino microcontrollers. 3. Serial communication programming for AVR and Arduino microcontrollers. 4. Analog-to-digital (AD) conversion programming for Arduino microcontrollers. 5. Pulse-width modulation (PWM) output programming for Arduino microcontrollers.

activityGoals.body: Understand the role of microcontrollers and the structure of microcontroller programs
Understand the role of I/O ports, and write and run I/O port programs
Understand the timer interrupt, and write and run timer interrupt programs
Understand serial communication, and write and run serial communication programs
